name: Wildeck
summary:
Wildeck is a free-to-play online collectible card game that gives players complete freedom to build their own strategies. Instead of being restricted to predefined classes, you create your deck by combining spells, creatures, and mechanics from any archetype to discover powerful synergies and unique playstyles.

Whether you prefer aggressive rush decks, methodical control, clever combo strategies, or something entirely original, Wildeck encourages experimentation and creativity. Every match is a test of deckbuilding, tactical decision-making, and adaptation.

The game is currently in active development, with community feedback playing a key role in shaping future cards, mechanics, and features.
